title: v = (4, 3) in the basis b₁, b₂
caption: In the new basis b₁ = (2, 1), b₂ = (1, 1) the vector v = (4, 3) has coordinates (1, 2): one step of b₁ then two steps of b₂ reach the same point.
alt: A grid with b₁ = (2, 1) from the origin, then two copies of b₂ = (1, 1) tip to tail to reach (4, 3), and v drawn straight from the origin to (4, 3).
description: b₁ = (2, 1) takes you from the origin to (2, 1).
Two steps of b₂ = (1, 1) go from (2, 1) to (4, 3).
So v = 1·b₁ + 2·b₂, coordinates (1, 2) in the new basis, and (4, 3) in the standard basis.
